analysis:
Integration review of all 35 units. No concrete security regression is supported by the supplied evidence. The cross-file themes below remain unverified contracts.

1) GLM weight-hash path (T-012, T-027, T-041, A-004): StandaloneServer.swift (~1964-2006) and ProviderLoop+ModelLoading.swift (~546-635) drop the separate pre/post WeightHasher passes for managed GLM loads. They rely on GLM5NextManagedLoad.verifiedArtifactSHA256 plus requireGLM5NextLoadedArtifact and recordVerifiedGLM5NextWeightHash. A new VerifiedWeightHashStore (verified-weights.json, 0600, keyed to dev/inode/size/mtime/ctime) lets registration reuse a hash (Darkbloom.swift ~171-229, StartCommand+Modes.swift 216-217, Serve.swift 108). The changelog says the load verifies every manifest file before serving and fails on a changed file identity. Tests (GLM5NextManagedLoadTests, VerifiedWeightHashStoreTests) support this. However, the managed-load implementation, the store, the registration gating on weightsVerifiedByManagedLoad, and the head of the StandaloneServer hunk were not seen. They should be confirmed: fail-closed on a nil or mismatched digest, the aggregate compared to the manifest, and no reuse of a stale record. The operator is already the adversary in T-012, and the registered hash is self-reported, so this adds no new trust claim.

2) GLM structured output and forced tool_choice (T-008, A-001): the policy now admits json response_format, required/named tool_choice and strict tools. Safety depends on withholding output until it validates (GLM5NextResponseFormat, ToolChoiceEnforcementPolicy.structuredPostValidation). Tests assert no PRIVATE-marker echo in 422 errors, and media requests are refused before any work. The production withholding consumers were not visible. ToolConstraintSchema.requireExplicitResponseTypes is stricter, not looser.

3) GLM5NextWiredLimitNotice.report(error, modelID:) is called at load, stream-start, preload and recordModelLoadError sites (InferenceHandler 577/1023, Trust:129, StartupPreloader). Its implementation is unseen. Confirm it logs only fixed, content-free text (A-001; modelId is request-derived). The ProviderOperationalMessage addition is closed-vocabulary.

4) Smaller items: firstWithheldOutputAt semantics (deadline and billing only), PageCache mmap/msync, unsupportedOutputControl mapped to HTTP 400 without detail, and the test seams in ProviderLoop+Testing (internal, not production-wired). The rest are doctor/start advisories, a memory-admission change and test or script updates. The tests show freeOnly stays fail-closed, but the production SystemMemory change and its overflow saturation (pageSize .max) were not supplied.

T-041 cache storage code is untouched.
